```c
// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (41x512x512).
// Optimization: swap loop order to j0-outer, i0-inner so B tiles and B scales
// are loaded once per j0 block and reused across all i0 iterations.
void solution(void) {
  const int GK = MATMUL_K / 32;

  // Static pre-staged scale arrays: [block_idx][scale_group][elem_in_block]
  static uint8_t pre_A_s[BLOCKS_M][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];
  static uint8_t pre_B_s[BLOCKS_N][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];

  // One-time restride: copy from strided scales into contiguous buffers.
  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++)
    for (int g = 0; g < GK; g++)
      memcpy(&pre_A_s[i0][g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);

  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++)
    for (int g = 0; g < GK; g++)
      memcpy(&pre_B_s[j0][g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);

  int tiles   = BLK / DIM;
  int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
  uint32_t a_base = 0;
  uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles * tiles_K * DIM;
  int SPAD_DEST = 128;

  // Outer loop over j0 (columns / weights): load B once per j0.
  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
    if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;
    if (ncols <= 0) continue;

    // Flush and configure once per j0 block.
    gemmini_flush(0);
    gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                                1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

    // Load B scales once for all i0 iterations (sel=1 for weights/B).
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)pre_B_s[j0], B_S_BYTES, 1);

    // Load B tiles into scratchpad once; they persist for all i0.
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));
    for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++)
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
        gemmini_extended_mvin2(
            (void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
            b_base + (k * tiles + j) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

    // Inner loop over i0 (rows / activations): A changes each iteration.
    for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
      if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
      if (mrows <= 0) continue;

      int pad_i = BLK - mrows;
      int pad_j = BLK - ncols;

      // Programming model sequence:
      // 1. config_ex (already issued at j0 level; format unchanged, re-issue
      //    to satisfy strict ordering requirement before load_scales).
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                                  1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

      // 2. Load A scales (sel=0 for activations/A).
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)pre_A_s[i0], A_S_BYTES, 0);

      // B scales (sel=1) were loaded at the j0 level and persist in hardware
      // state — they have not been overwritten, so they remain valid here.

      // 3. Load A tiles into scratchpad.
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin(
              (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
              a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

      // 4. Configure requantized mvout and execute fused matmul.
      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors,
                                   tiles, tiles, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0,
                           a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST,
                           false, false, false, false, false,
                           NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // 5. Drain BF16 results from smem to DRAM, row by row.
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++)
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][(j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD],
                             SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * BLK, ncols);
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
```
